_description: Swappable Tick/Error Mark Packs & SFX Packs for Claude Editor. Set 'mark_style' or 'sfx_pack' at the plan root or override 'style' / 'asset' / 'sfx' per mark item. Editors can also drop any custom PNG into assets/marks/<custom_name>.png and reference it by name.
_how_to_add_custom_marks: 1. Drop your custom PNG files into assets/marks/ (e.g., assets/marks/neon_right.png and assets/marks/neon_wrong.png).
2. Either reference them directly in a mark entry via {"type": "wrong", "style": "neon_wrong.png"} (or "asset": "neon_wrong.png"),
3. Or name a pair <pack>_right.png and <pack>_wrong.png in assets/marks/ and set "mark_style": "<pack>" in plan.json — resolve_mark_asset() auto-discovers <style>_right.png / <style>_wrong.png!
